transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. It's nice to meet you too. I came in because I'm just having a really hard time keeping things straight. I feel like I cannot get my schoolwork and my little accessories shop organized at the same time. 

It's just... my supplies, due dates, receipts, assignment notes, they all just end up in these big piles everywhere. I look at it all and I honestly just don't know what to do first.
Have you had trouble staying organized since you were a child?

Yeah, it's definitely been an issue for a long time. Actually, my mom still has some of my old elementary school notes from my teachers. They were always pointing out that I was constantly getting out of my seat, or that I'd just start talking before I was even called on. And, um, they also said I was always rushing through our group activities, even when I actually understood the work we were doing. So, yeah, it's been like this since I was little.
Do you often have trouble focusing on what someone is saying, even when you’re trying to pay attention?

Yeah, I definitely do. Like, if I'm in class, or even when I'm watching a video for my business assignments, I can start out listening just fine. But after a few minutes, my mind just... drifts. I'll start thinking about new charm designs or order ideas for the shop, and then I suddenly realize I completely missed half of what was said.
Do these focus and organization problems cause trouble in other parts of your life besides school and your shop?

Yeah, it definitely does. Um, because of all this... I actually missed some required steps for my school program, and now my financial aid is at risk, which is really stressful. And even with the shop, the people I work with on projects have started depending on me less. I think they just realize I can't keep things together, so it's really starting to affect everything.
Do you get unwanted thoughts that keep coming into your mind even when you try to ignore them?

Um, no, not really. I mean, my mind bounces around a lot, like I mentioned, but it's not... it's not like bad thoughts or things I'm trying to block out. It's just me getting distracted by normal things, like ideas for my shop. So, no, I don't really get unwanted thoughts that just won't go away.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about a lot of different things?

No, not really. I mean, I get stressed out when things go wrong—like with the financial aid situation I just mentioned—but I wouldn't say I worry excessively about a bunch of different things. I don't really sit around feeling anxious about everything in general. It's usually just... more like frustration with myself for falling behind, rather than actually worrying all the time.
